title: ParadeDB (YC S23) Is Hiring Distributed Systems/Platform Engineers
summary: ParadeDB, a Y Combinator S23 batch company, is recruiting experienced distributed systems and platform engineers to build their product. This is a hiring post from a well-funded database startup looking to expand their engineering team.
problem_solved: Addresses the talent acquisition need for building ParadeDB's next-generation database product targeting enterprise search workloads.
why_valuable: Offers an opportunity to join a YC-backed startup with potential to work on challenging distributed systems problems at scale.
